name: Last Days of Spring
source: Last Days of Spring is a kinetic otome novel following a group of high school seniors in their last week of school as they come to terms with questions about love, life and destiny. Follow the steps of Yuka Kishimoto as she navigates across her final week as a high school student and sees her life come to a complete change!
translation: 《春日终焉》是一部动静皆宜的乙女视觉小说，讲述一群高中毕业生在毕业前最后一周面对爱情、人生与命运等问题的故事。跟随岸本由香的脚步，见证她作为高中生的最后一周，以及生活如何彻底改变！
